Its stated goal is shortening the handoff from digital sample review to a physical prototype decision.

feedback.routing: Partner lead checks for confidential material, then routes workflow defects to solutions and product defects to product. Record an owner and response date; no automatic sending.
feedback.close_the_loop_message: We reviewed the issue you raised. Here is what changed, what remains open, and the next review date. Please tell us whether this addresses the problem in your workflow.

stage_definitions.Introduction: Partner confirms the problem and chooses whether to continue.
stage_definitions.Education: Partner can explain the limits and approves one safe test.
stage_definitions.Experimentation: Every untested claim stays explicitly unapproved. Proposed threshold; agree with the partner before testing.
stage_definitions.Adoption: Partner repeats the agreed task independently with approved inputs.
stage_definitions.Long-term engagement: Partner and owner agree to continue, adjust or stop based on actual use.

leading_indicators: Time from session to first approved trial
Whether the partner independently repeats the task
Feedback items closed with a partner response
metrics.time_to_activation_target: Planning assumption: 1–3 months to independent repeat use; agree a baseline and target with the partner. Attendance does not count as activation.

flags.issue: Fictional fixture evidence is not verified public research.
flags.suggested_fix: Confirm every fact and boundary before real outreach.

flags.issue: Scores, time estimates and thresholds are planning judgments, not measured outcomes.
flags.suggested_fix: Review weights and agree thresholds before a test.

claims_audit: All source references point to labeled fictional persona briefs.
No real quotes, follower counts or measured outcomes are claimed.
Workflow steps and time-to-value are labeled hypotheses.
IP, disclosure and sustainability items are review prompts, not legal conclusions.

workflow.process: Material review must happen before the physical sample order.
workflow.pain_points: Performance statements are reaching the handoff without a linked test record.
workflow.human_judgment: The engineer approves test claims and the designer approves construction intent.

changes.reason: The supplied workflow identifies unsubstantiated performance language as the immediate handoff blocker.
Sample context E6 changes which task should be prepared first.

changes.after: Seed an untested waterproofing statement and verify it remains blocked.
changes.reason: The experiment follows the more specific context rather than the name-only hypothesis.

tracking.business_context: A product-design team is testing whether synthetic review records help designers and material engineers agree sample decisions.
tracking.why_critical: A repeatable design-to-engineering handoff can connect creative use to actual product decisions. Technical claim accuracy is the key adoption gate.
tracking.current_workflow: Digital garment sample → cross-functional specification review → physical prototype decision → approved product information.

event.title: Digital sample pilot review
event.audience: Product design, material engineering, merchandising and partner lead

implementation.title: Digital sample deployment
implementation.objective: Roll out a review standard for synthetic digital-to-physical sample handoffs.
implementation.solution_workflow: Synthetic tech pack → design/engineering review → verified claim ledger → prototype gate.
implementation.environment: Fictional sandbox using synthetic or explicitly cleared material. No production or owner data.
success_criteria: The customer approves a specific, repeatable workflow.
Every release has a named human approval owner.
Training supports independent repeat use; attendance alone is insufficient.
